step_by_step_reasoning:
Analyzing the whiteboard architecture diagram:
1. Bottom container shows SAP application components: an EC2 instance ('EC2 App') and SAP Database ('SAP DB').
2. Infrastructure monitoring is handled by CloudWatch, receiving metrics/logs from the EC2 application.
3. Application monitoring is done by a Lambda function connected to CloudWatch.
4. Events are caught by CloudWatch Events ('CW EVENTS'), which triggers Amazon SNS ('SNS').
5. SNS sends notifications to an external target (Email/ITSM) and triggers a healing Lambda function ('LAMBDA').
6. The healing Lambda uses AWS Systems Manager ('SSM') to issue commands back to the EC2/SAP instances to recover the application.
